name: RMS Marine Service US LLC
summary: One-stop marine service from the Port of Houston: stores, provisions, spare parts, safety service, technical service and logistics for vessels calling the US Gulf, the East and West Coasts, Canada and Panama.

emergency.title: 24/7/365 cover
emergency.text: RMS keeps its spare parts desk and its safety service division on call 7 days a week, 24 hours a day, and the Houston office publishes an after-office-hours line on +1-832-560-5886.

hero.eyebrow: Marine service from the Port of Houston
hero.title: Make your voyage
hero.lead: RMS Marine Service US LLC works from a 4,000 square metre warehouse in the Port of Houston, supplying stores, provisions, spare parts, safety service, technical service and logistics to vessels across North America, backed by the RMS Group network of 19 offices.

groups.title: Stores Supply
groups.summary: Deck, engine, cabin, electrical and safety stores from a 4,000 square metre warehouse in the Port of Houston.
groups.intro: Stores supply is the RMS core. The group holds more than 55,000 SKU in stock across warehouses in China, Singapore, Korea, Rotterdam, Dubai and the USA, coded to IMPA and the RMS coding system and bar-code labelled. RMS supplies only marine standard and quality stores, and delivers stores to more than 55,000 vessels a year worldwide.

services.title: Consumable and Technical Stores
services.text: Standard supplies for the deck, engine, cabin, electrical and safety departments, on quarterly or semi-annual schedules.
points: Stock coded by IMPA and the RMS coding system, bar-code labelled
Customised supply for docking vessels with urgent or technical needs
Stock replenishment supply for global suppliers

services.title: Bulk and Project Stores
services.text: Technical stores bought in bulk and to order, from lashing materials to project cables and pipework.
points: Lashing materials, anchor chain, anchors and anodes
Bulk purchasing for PPE, crockery, non-single-use plastic replacement and 110V / 60Hz electrical appliances
Cables, valves and pipes for BWMS and scrubber projects
Wire rope and mooring rope compliant with MEG4

services.title: Newbuilding Initial Supply
services.text: RMS has delivered more than 4,500 newbuilding initial supplies in China, Korea, Japan, Vietnam and the Philippines, for bulk carriers, general cargo ships, tankers and container ships.
points: Initial stores for over 3,700 vessels in Chinese shipyards and over 800 overseas
International standard packing SOP for easy checking and labelling
Packing list with IMPA number coding, recyclable packing

services.title: Export Service
services.text: Wholesale marine standard products and initial supply for trading companies, shipyards and ship builders outside China, with global forwarding and local checking support.
points: Deck, engine, cabin, electrical and safety stores wholesale
IMO signals and flags, deck fittings, hatch cover spares, wire and mooring rope
Professional packing and labelling to the client's request

groups.title: Provisions Supply
groups.summary: Fresh, frozen, dry and beverage provisions for merchant vessels, offshore facilities and cruise ships.
groups.intro: RMS has supplied provisions to international shipping companies for over three decades. The group runs more than 10,000 square metres of provisions stock and 7,000 cubic metres of freezer space with refrigerated trucks, and is certified to ISO 22000 food safety management, working to HACCP standards for food handling, temperature control, QC, labelling and traceability.

services.title: Fresh Provisions
services.text: Fruit and vegetables, eggs and dairy products, handled under temperature control from store to deck.

services.title: Frozen Provisions
services.text: Frozen meat, poultry and seafood, and frozen fruit and vegetables, held in 7,000 cubic metres of cold storage.

services.title: Dry Goods and Beverage
services.text: Canned products, rice, flour and oil, coffee and teas, sauces, spices and herbs, snacks, nuts and dried fruit, plus wine, beer and soft drinks.

services.title: Cruise and Offshore Catering
services.text: RMS also supplies well-known cruise companies with food and beverage, hotel and strategic sourcing services to support their global operations.

groups.title: Spare Parts and Equipment
groups.summary: Genuine spare parts for main and auxiliary engines, engine room and deck auxiliary equipment, supplied since 2008.
groups.intro: The RMS spare parts team has supplied genuine spare parts worldwide since 2008 and is authorised by 100 well-regarded makers. Centralised purchasing keeps the price competitive, and the team promises 7 x 24 non-stop service with one-stop warehousing and logistics at major ports and shipyards in China, Korea, Singapore, Europe, the UAE and the USA.

services.title: Main and Auxiliary Engine Spares
services.text: Original spare parts inventory for MAN, WinGD and CSSC engines.
points: Cylinder liners and piston rings
FIVA and fuel injection system spares

services.title: Hatch Cover and Deck Spares
services.text: Hydraulic cylinders, hydraulic motors and control valves for hatch cover equipment.

services.title: Pumps, Motors and Coolers
services.text: Pump spares for Japanese and Chinese brands, electric motors in original and tailor-made form, and plates and gaskets for fresh water generators and coolers in European, Japanese and Korean brands.
points: Tailor-made electric motors built in China with a long warranty period

services.title: Owners' Spares Handling
services.text: RMS USA handles logistics for owners' spare parts alongside its own supply, delivering to the designated port, shipyard or destination.

The division works from 11 self-owned workshops with 100 trained and certified technicians, is approved by 10 classification societies and is authorised by makers including SIKA, Riken Keiki, Scott, Lalizas, CSM, Hatecke, Oriental, Jiaoyan and Qingdao Beihai. Service is offered 24/7/365.

The team takes a project from technical consulting, proposal assessment and equipment selection through site survey, design, installation and commissioning, for newbuilding, retrofit and shipyard repair work, backed by a global after-sales network. The aim is to optimise the client's systems so the vessel burns less fuel at lower cost.

about.title: A Houston branch with a global network behind it.
text: RMS Marine Service US LLC was established in 2023 and operates from a strategically positioned facility in the Port of Houston. With a 4,000 square metre warehouse, RMS USA is dedicated to providing reliable and responsive marine service solutions to meet the diverse needs of clients in North America.

Positioned strategically within the US Gulf area, RMS USA serves as a significant milestone in RMS's international service capacity. It complements the group's existing offices in China, Korea, Singapore, the Netherlands and the UAE.

RMS USA offers a wide array of services, ranging from food and technical stores to spare parts, logistic handling for owners' spare parts, safety service testing and calibration, engineering services and export services. More services are in the pipeline as RMS Group continuously advances as a one-stop marine service company.

Backed by the trust of global customers and supported by our headquarters, the local expertise team at RMS Marine Service US Branch is poised to become a lasting presence in the North American market.

faqs.q: Which ports does RMS USA cover?
faqs.a: Services span the United States, covering the US Gulf at Houston and New Orleans, the West Coast at Los Angeles and Long Beach, and the East Coast including New York. RMS also covers Canadian ports such as Vancouver and Quebec, and Panama in Central America.

faqs.q: What is in the Houston facility?
faqs.a: RMS Marine Service US LLC works from a 4,000 square metre warehouse in a strategically positioned facility in the Port of Houston.

faqs.q: Who do I contact for a particular service?
faqs.a: Stores at us@rmsmarineservice.us, provisions at food@rmsmarineservice.com, spare parts and equipment at spare-euro@rmsmarineservice.com, FSR safety service at FSRglobal@rmsmarineservice.com, technical service at service@ptmarineservice.com and logistics transit and care-off at logistics@rmsmarineservice.us.

The Houston branch shows ISO 9001 and ISO 14001 certificates for the US company. At group level RMS holds ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 22000 and ISO 45001, and its safety and life-saving services are certified by 10 classification societies: NK, BV, ABS, CCS, RS, KR, LR, DNV-GL, IRS and RINA.

faqs.q: Can RMS supply a newbuilding or a vessel in dry dock?
faqs.a: Yes. RMS has delivered more than 4,500 newbuilding initial supplies worldwide, and its site service team of more than 70 boarding officers attends docking vessels on a daily basis.
